- [2019] Take That and Robbie Williams reunited for the "Greatest Hits Live" tour, marking the first time all five members performed together in over 20 years.
- [2019] The tour featured Take That's biggest hits and some of Robbie Williams' solo tracks, focusing on celebrating the band's legacy rather than promoting new material.
- [2019] The tour included the performance of the band's 2018 single "Out of Our Heads."
- [2019] The tour's production included giant LED screens, moving screens, impressive light shows, and a giant mechanical elephant centerpiece.
- [2019] Robbie Williams' father, Peter Conway, made a guest appearance, playing drums during "Never Forget."
- [2019] Robbie Williams invited a fan on stage to sing "Angels" with him during the tour.
- [2019] The band performed a tribute to George Michael with "Freedom! '90" on some nights.
- [2019] The tour visited the UK, Austria, Netherlands, Germany, Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Russia, Belarus, Poland, Romania, Bulgaria, North Macedonia, Serbia, and Ireland.
- [2019] The tour consisted of 46 shows, ending in July in Dublin, Ireland.
- [2019] The creative process for the tour was a collaborative effort between Take That members and the production team, with significant input from the band in designing the production.
